Desc: On collision, has a 50% chance to activate the nearest component.  passes charge to components on collision. balls can hold more than one charge, all charges are passed to a component if that component can take them.
Creates an explosion that collides with all objects in the radius.
Changes and becomes more powerful after certain requirements are met.
Activates components 1-4 times per second, increasing score by 25% each time.  Fire stacks up to 4 times, increasing the frequency per second
Shatters on next collision, doubling the scoring of that collision and applying increased knockback.
Pulls balls in with either weak or strong force.
Increased knockback, increased score based on the velocity of the colliding ball  Scoring scales from 75-200%
Any object that has "X in Y" chances has Odds. Increasing odds means lowering Y by that amount.
When any component with Paired is activated, all components with Paired are activated.
Gives the opportunity to acquire more drones and upgrade them.
Destroys items in exchange for rewards.
Turns an object into a different object with the same rarity and construction.
